name: omnihr
label: Omni HR
description: Smart, all-in-one HR platform for managing employees, time tracking, and HR workflows

get_employee_info.label: Get Employee Details by System ID
get_employee_info.description: Retrieves detailed employee information using their system ID

system_id.label: System ID
system_id.description: The system ID of the employee

get_direct_reports.label: Get Employee Direct Reports
get_direct_reports.description: Retrieves a list of employees who directly report to the specified employee

system_id.label: User ID
system_id.description: The user ID of the employee

generateReport.label: Generate Report
generateReport.description: Generate Custom Report. For Snapshot report templates, optionally generate the report as of a past date

reportTemplateId.label: Report Template
reportTemplateId.description: The custom report template to generate a report from

mapFieldNames.label: Map Field Names
mapFieldNames.description: If enabled, row keys are mapped from field IDs to their human-readable names as defined in the report template. Any field that cannot be mapped keeps its ID. Caveat: if two fields share the same name, only one will appear in the output as the other is overwritten.
